title: Context pack builder and the conversation + acceptance signals
description:
New module src/papyrus_content/ideas/context_packs.py.
- Pack dataclass and JSON shape exactly as design section 5.1: packId (sha256 of site|signal|anchor|window, 12 chars), signal {type, anchor, windowDays, count, expected, correctedPValue, surprise, dateBasis}, concepts (handle C#, hashtag, name, kind, description, recentCount, baselineCount), references (handle R#, title, url, published, added, publishedBasis, summary, acceptedBy, acceptedOn, concepts, status), edges, messages (handle M#, about, author label, date, text), recent_published_stories, existing_ideas, mission, policy, allowed_sections.
- Pending References appear with status "pending" and a note "not yet accepted"; they get handles P# so the citation check can refuse them as evidence.
- conversation signal: entity = a Reference or Story with a Message thread; series = Messages per day in the thread; baseline = the thread's own earlier days vs all Messages on the site (scan_window, day buckets, S1.1).
- acceptance signal: entity = a concept; series = human accepts per week of References linked to it (mentions or related_to); baseline = the concept's own earlier weeks vs all human accepts; ingestion basis.
- Ranking: every pack carries correctedPValue and surprise; packs from different signals interleave by surprise, round-robin by signal.
- Summaries from the reference_summary_200_tokens Message or the metadata attachment summary; no page fetch.
- recent_published_stories = stories published since the anchor's baseline began (replaces STORY_DAYS = 90 in ideas/context.py for this path).
- A pack is trimmed only to synthesis.MAXIMUM_INPUT_CHARACTERS, lowest-ranked members first.
Unit tests per signal with fixtures: a lit-up thread yields a pack; a concept at its own baseline yields none; a site with no Messages still yields acceptance packs; every pack states dateBasis.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
